serverInfo.name: @guardbee/mcp-memory-poisoning-scanner
serverInfo.description: MCP server that scans agent code for memory-poisoning risks — untrusted input written into persistent, cross-session memory (MemGPT-style archival/core memory, or a vector store used as a long-term knowledge base) that later gets recalled and trusted as context

tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Scan agent code for memory-poisoning risks: untrusted input written into persistent memory without sanitization, and memory retrievals fed into a system/assistant-role message or prompt template as trusted context.

label.description: Optional label shown in findings (e.g. filename)

tools.name: scan_file
tools.description: Scan a single file for memory-write and memory-readback poisoning patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to scan

tools.name: scan_directory
tools.description: Recursively scan a directory of agent source code for memory-poisoning patterns

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the directory to scan

maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to scan (default: 5000)

include.description: Only scan files whose path contains one of these strings

exclude.description: Skip files/dirs whose path contains one of these strings

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: List every memory-write and memory-readback pattern this scanner detects, grouped by category
